# Affirmpad / 어펌패드

> A free, ad-free affirmation practice pad with no account. Write your own
> affirmations under your own topics, put one sentence up fullscreen and tap
> once per repetition. Undo a slip, star favorites, switch to dark mode.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://affirmpad.try-dabble.com/
Affirmations, topics, practice counts and preferences stay in this browser on
this device. No accounts, no sign-in, no uploads, no server storage, no ads,
no in-app purchases, no subscription and no free trial that turns into a
yearly charge. Export a JSON backup to survive a reinstall or move phones.

This is NOT a guided meditation service, NOT a social feed and NOT a
subscription library of pre-written quotes. Every line is yours to write,
edit and delete; a few starter lines per language are included and removable.

- [Home](https://affirmpad.try-dabble.com/): The practice pad

## Features

- Custom affirmations: add, edit, delete; optional topic per line
- Topics (categories): add, rename, delete; unlimited and free
- Practice mode: one sentence set large, tap to count repetitions, undo, reset, session goal progress
- Fullscreen practice (Fullscreen API with a CSS fallback), exit by button or Escape; the count is kept
- Favorites: star / unstar, filter by favorites or by topic
- Soft click sound and short vibration on each tap, each with its own toggle (no-op where unsupported)
- Dark mode (deep indigo, lavender accents), persisted
- Text size A / A+ / A++
- JSON export / import of affirmations, topics and preferences; delete all data
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
